$comment: GET /v2/conferenceRecords/{conferenceRecordId}/transcripts -- verified against the Meet API v2 Discovery Document 2026-09-16. A conference has a transcript only when transcription was turned on for that meeting; this can come back empty. docsDestination.exportUri is a Google Docs export a human can open, separate from the per-utterance text transcript_entry_list reads.
title: List transcripts
description: List a finished conference's transcripts, when transcription was on.

config.label: Conference record ID
config.description: The id from conference_record_list's data.conferenceRecords[].name (conferenceRecords/{id} -- give the id after the slash).

outputShape.description: Usually one, unless the meeting was recorded in segments. Each has name (…/transcripts/{id} -- what transcript_entry_list needs), state, startTime, endTime, and docsDestination.exportUri (a Google Docs link, when export finished).
